_comment: Porter MCP server for Zencoder (VS Code + JetBrains). HOW TO APPLY (VS Code): merge the zencoder.mcpServers.porter block into your VS Code settings.json. NOTE the vendor-specific key: "zencoder.mcpServers", NOT "mcpServers". For JetBrains: Tools > Zencoder > MCP Servers UI. Replace {{PORTER_TOKEN}} with a real Porter access token. UNVERIFIED: not tested against a live Zencoder install here.
